title: keep going back to the same mall
content: for the last couple months every now and then i get a dream of a pretty large parking lot and a very like boring or dull outside of a mall, beige-ish but every time i enter the mall the insides are totally different, but DISTINCTLY im always outside before i go in and its always the same. the inside of the mall kinda varies on the overall theme of whatever dream was going on
